notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once (pools exactly 4x each count). Blocks: Ciencias Jurídicas 30, Ciencias Sociales 11, Técnico-Científicas 9 per test, roughly the share of the 45 temas (26/11/8). The real test is 100 questions with three options in 50 minutes, scored [A - E/(n-1)] x 10 / P; Tigertest models half its length with four options and no penalty, so passPct 70 is Tigertest's target. Training: six topic sets 22501-22506 (44/28/36/40/16/36) + 4 tests = 10 dashboard steps.
